summary: Reitar Logtech filed a Form 6-K disclosing a September 10, 2026 Nasdaq Staff Delisting Determination after its securities closed at $0.10 or below for 10 consecutive trading days (August 25–September 9, 2026). Trading suspends at the open on September 17, 2026. Reitar submitted a hearing request to the Nasdaq Hearings Department by the September 17, 4:00 p.m. ET deadline, appealing the determination; a timely request does not stay suspension. Absent a successful appeal, Nasdaq will file Form 25-NSE to delist and deregister the Class A ordinary shares. Watch hearing timing, compliance-plan credibility, and OTC transition risk.
